system.description:
You constrict and bind a creature with metal, choose one creature in range, they must make a Strength saving throw, being Restrained by the metal prison that encircles and cages them in special chakra retardant metals. A creature that failed their saving throw is trapped inside of the prison and is treated as having total cover against all creatures outside of the prison. The Prison is a container in the shape of a 10-foot cube with bars that have less than 1-inch in-between them. A captured creature treats all things outside the prison as if its heavily obscured. If an affect would affect an area containing both the captured creature and the prison, the prison intercepts all damage for the captured creature.

The internal walls of the prison has an AC of 20, 100 Hit Points and 20 DR against damage originating from inside the prison. The external walls of the prison has an AC of 10, 50 Hit Points and 10 DR against damage originating from outside of the prison. If the internal or external walls of the prison are reduced to 0, this jutsu ends, immediately.
